question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 2.
solution:
The correct answer is **"undoubtedly."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **"Undoubtedly"** means without doubt or certainly and is the most appropriate word to fill in the blank. (बिना किसी संदेह के या निश्चित रूप से)

 
 
• **Example**: *Bacteria evolve so fast they will **undoubtedly**__ find a way to overcome this, too.*
 
 
 
• The other options do not fit the context of the sentence or create a contradictory meaning.
 
• The correct answer is Option 2.
 
• Correct passage:

A beautiful spectacle for anyone to __behold__ would be the crowds that throng to see the Indian cricket team playing, whether it be in India or in other parts of the globe. This __undoubtedly__ is the occasion where the spirit of oneness is all pervasive. India with all its diversity ______ (3) ______ be seen either rejoicing or moaning depending on the sway of the game ______ (4) ______ watched. Unity in diversity is ______ (5) ______ in all its glory.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Ruthlessly** means without pity or compassion. (बिना दया या करुणा के)
 
• **Doubtfully** means uncertainly or hesitantly. (अनिश्चित रूप से या झिझकते हुए)
 
• **Indefinitely** means without a fixed or certain end. (जिसका कोई निश्चित अंत न हो)
